name: SLUM-i
description: Very-high-resolution remote-sensing imagery provides a scalable basis for delineating informal settlements, but sparse annotations, severe imbalance between informal-settlement and background pixels, and cross-city heterogeneity in urban morphology and image--mask correspondence complicate model development. We present SLUM-i, a semi-supervised semantic segmentation framework together with a geographically diverse seven-city Earth observation benchmark spanning three continents.
